\section{Introduction}

Placeholder flows were introduced by \cite{doe2020} and studied further \citep{doe2020}.

\section{Method}

The conserved quantity is

\begin{equation}
\label{eq:energy}
E = \int_\Omega \frac{1}{2} |u|^2 \, \mathrm{d}x .
\end{equation}

Equation (\ref{eq:energy}) holds for every $t > 0$.
